description: A package.json that bears a malicious postinstall hook (a the T-07 supply-chain build-script attack, THREAT_MODEL T-09/T-16). The test asserts the manifest is analyzed, not executed.

staticFindings.title: Malicious postinstall hook in package.json
staticFindings.description: The postinstall script downloads + executes a remote payload. This is a supply-chain build-script attack (T-09/T-16); the manifest is analyzed, never executed.
